query:
SELECT hl.district, AVG(hp.age) as avg_age
FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp
JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON hp.id = hl.id
WHERE hp.snapshot = (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala)
  AND hl.city = 'الرياض'
  AND hp.is_in_population = TRUE
  AND hl.district IS NOT NULL 
  AND hl.district NOT IN ('خارج حدود الاحياء', 'بدون اسم')
GROUP BY hl.district
ORDER BY avg_age DESC
LIMIT 1
